output:
## Draft reply

Hi Ada,

Thank you for your note. I understand you'd like to collect your necklace with the new clasp.

You can book a Pick up appointment here, which takes about 10 minutes:
https://app.acuityscheduling.com/schedule.php?owner=16919152

I work by appointment only, so please choose a time from that page. We're at The Winslow Showroom, Harbor Square, 752 Winslow Way East, Bainbridge Island. If you have any trouble booking, call me on 206-605-1510.

I look forward to seeing you.

Warmly,
Alina

## Intake note for Alina

- **Reported issue:** Ada says you emailed yesterday to say her necklace, with a new clasp, is ready. She wants to book a collection time.
- **Not known yet:** I can't see your records or sent emails, so I haven't confirmed the email or that the piece is ready.
- **Decisions for you:** Check that the necklace is ready before sending. If it isn't, replace the Pick up suggestion with a note that you'll write back.
- **Suggested appointment:** Pick up (10 minutes), because Ada says the studio told her the piece is ready.
